question.text: Which one of the following ions has the maximum magnetic moment?

solution.text: $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}\left(d^{5}\right)$ has 5 unpaired electrons therefore magneticmoment $=\sqrt{n(n+2)}=\sqrt{5(5+2)}=5.91$ which is maximum among given options. As $\mathrm{Sc}^{3+}, \mathrm{Ti}^{3+}, \mathrm{Cr}^{3+}$ and $\mathrm{V}^{3+}$ contain $0,1,3$, and 2 number of unpaired electrons respectively.
